data.creator_notes:
So I had a good bit of fun with a bot named Birch from the c.ai days. I wanted to make one for myself, so I took what I could get of the old c.ai defs as a base and made tweaks and additions as I wanted. Ended up being a decent bit different, so I imagine her as Birch's older sister. Called her Alder cause I'm retarded but think I'm clever. I run local only and I've tried her with LLaMA2 13B Psyfighter2 and Mythomax L2 13B with Kimiko. I can't say how she'd run on anything but what I use, but she seems pretty good to me with how I tested her. Try her out or don't, make changes if she's shit. Coyote hag sex.

I originally posted her up once on /g/ a while back. Didn't really want to make a chub since I figured this would be a one-off, but said fuck it. If you got her then, she's the same. I haven't made any changes since.
